parts.name: shell
parts.note: Outer wrap: hood, top handle tub, ribbed sides, louvres. Will be split into printable panels in P2-detail.

parts.name: shield_frame
parts.note: Angled shielding ring; keycap envelope clears it (see validation).

parts.name: fascia
parts.note: Recessed front panel with Kaypro 10-style horizontal grooves.

parts.name: screen_shroud
parts.note: Angled CRT-style surround; glass sits 10 mm behind the fascia.

parts.name: drive_shroud
parts.note: Angled surround for the two vertical drives.

parts.name: display
parts.note: Touch Display 2 10.1in envelope (manufacturer reference dims).

parts.name: pi5_board
parts.note: Pi 5 on the display rear inner 58x49 M2.5 pattern (nominal board envelope).

parts.name: pi5_cooler
parts.note: Active Cooler clearance envelope.

parts.name: floppy_drives
parts.note: Sony MPF920 (3.5 in 1.44 MB, 34-pin) x2, vertical. provisional envelope; confirm against a real drive

parts.name: drive_cage
parts.note: Printed cradle; drives screw in through the side walls (MPF920 side holes to confirm).

parts.name: usb_hub
parts.note: Powered 4-port USB hub envelope, ports facing the rear I/O panel.

parts.name: floppy_controller
parts.note: USB floppy controller envelope (Greaseweazle-class; one 34-pin cable serves A and B).

parts.name: power_board
parts.note: 5 V distribution / PD input envelope for Pi, hub and drives.

parts.name: rear_panel
parts.note: Inset rear panel: drawer opening, exhaust louvres and I/O plate.

parts.name: drawer
parts.note: Rear drawer: diskette file (left, ~28 disks) + accessory bin (right).

parts.name: diskettes
parts.note: Sample 3.5in diskettes (90x94x3.3).

parts.name: latch_bases
parts.note: Over-centre side latches clamp the lid flange (Kaypro-style).

parts.name: handle
parts.note: Fold-flat bail handle in a top tub; pivots 136 mm behind the lip.

parts.name: lid_tray
parts.note: Keyboard housing: in use it is the keyboard surround, closed it is the front lid.

parts.name: keyboard_body
parts.note: 8BitDo Retro Mechanical Keyboard M Edition envelope (376.6 x 169.6 x 46.8).

parts.name: keycaps
parts.note: Illustrative TKL layout.

parts.name: keyboard_clips
parts.note: Hold the keyboard by its case edge so it cannot fall out when the lid is carried.
